headline: Google ties China-linked hackers to attacks on AI research
body: A quiet day with one story. Google's threat team linked a China-nexus group to intrusions at North American military, academic and medical research bodies, including AI-related intellectual property. State-backed hacking raises Catastrophic Risk, which lifts Self-Destruction and weighs on the peaceful-coexistence endings. Horizon Balance slipped to +2.35.
